name: One phone on a 3G network
environment: this machine: the park under wrangler dev on port 8797, the stand-in store on port 8791
hypothesis: A phone on 3G comes into the hub and can play (its owl walks, the others are there), and the load screen's bar shows the bytes as they come: it only grows, in steps, while the park loads (OP-129).
blast_radius: One scripted phone page in the throwaway park, its network and processor slowed.
abort_rule: Any steady-state check failing for more than 30 s during the experiment ends it and runs the rollback; the harness never leaves a fault injected.

observations.what: a phone on 3G into the hub by address
observations.fix: load less before the room opens on a slow network (OP-129: the art the first frame needs, the rest after)

observations.what: the load screen's bar while the phone loaded
observations.value: 14 steps between empty and full, 0 back, up to 100%, up 9.7 s
observations.fix: move the bar by the bytes as they come (loadArt's onProgress), never by a timer, and never back within a load

observations.value: its owl walked where it was told, 10 other owls in view of the room
observations.fix: keep the slow phone in step: its walks and the others it is told about
